description: Read Arroway for a project BEFORE acting on any task related to it. It serves the authored essence of memories, dated-log entries and handoffs by default; name a #handle in include to recover that object's full body.

handoff.description: Optional: #handle of an OPEN handoff you are continuing; the read is built from its reading list (none: falls back to the normal read). Cannot be combined with include.

include.description: #handles whose full body you need; they come first, so others fall out — it chooses, it does not add.

since.description: Optional: checkpoint from a previous read of THIS project, so standing rules are not reprinted. Omit after compaction or in a new conversation.

task_context.description: Optional: what you are about to do; it ranks results. The declaration alone is NOT evidence of use: a matching completion residue from the same session must corroborate it.

name: arroway_read
title: Read Arroway
